model_check: The corollary states deterministic O(n^2.99294792) APSP for polynomially bounded integer weights and no negative cycles, on a word RAM with O(log n)-bit words (note, Results and scope). Directed graphs, as in the source reduction. Like other written claims, the fixed-width program and word-width quantifiers of EndStatement are an algorithmic interpretation, not a checked formal statement equivalence. Source comparison, not a proof check.
